`public $context, $d = 'abcdefghij', $p = 0;` — a stream wrapper declaring its state on one line —
was a COMPILE ERROR. The parser stopped at the comma and then met the class's closing brace at
statement position, so one ordinary property line became four errors and a refused program. Three
of an audit round's programs are exactly this.
